reviews.title: Don’t buy this app because the developer may limit or remove key features shortly after purchase!!!
reviews.text:
I paid for a yearly subscription to Remini mainly because the app allowed advanced photo editing using prompts and AI instructions. That feature was the core reason why I subscribed. Now, during an active paid subscription, this functionality has either been removed or heavily restricted without any fair compensation or option to cancel and receive a refund.
Changing the core functionality of a paid app halfway through a subscription period is unacceptable. Users are paying for a product based on the features advertised at the time of purchase. Removing or limiting those features later feels misleading and dishonest.
What makes this even worse is that there is no convincing explanation for taking away creative tools people already paid for access to. No matter how the developer tries to justify it, reducing functionality during an active subscription simply cannot be defended.
People should think carefully before subscribing to apps like this. Today you pay for one set of features, tomorrow they can quietly remove them while still charging the same price.
Main problems:
• Important AI prompt editing tools disappeared
• Paid users were not properly protected
• Subscription terms effectively changed during the contract period
• No fair downgrade compensation
• Features users relied on can vanish at any time
• Customer trust is clearly not a priority
I do not recommend this app!

Just a word of advice/warning to anyone looking to use the Remini app for AI photos. Especially those who are looking to create AI Photos from photos of couples or even individuals.

Of course, nude and explicit photos will result in a practically immediate “Something went wrong..” error/message, but if you’re looking for authenticity and accuracy in your AI creations, don’t waste your time using this Remini app. It will NOT generate photos of any woman that has anything that even remotely resembles a bosom. And it will make all your female AI generations almost flat chested.

I have also personally reached out to Remini about this issue numerous times and all you constantly get back from them, is a generic AI generated response about deleting and recreating an Ai Profile in the app. Their customer service/support is practically null and void, at this point. They have fallen a LONG way from being one of the best and most competent AI apps available and they need to do better. Currently considering canceling my subscription of at least 5 years.

reviews.title: App is unusable on multiple devices.
reviews.text:
I’m really disappointed with how this app functions, and I want to share my experience so others know what they’re getting into. I purchased the Lite subscription, and at first it worked for a couple of photos — and then everything fell apart.

After only a few uses, the app suddenly stopped working entirely. Every time I try to use a preset or load a photo, I get the same error message: “Oops! Something went wrong. Please check your internet connection and try again later.” My internet connection is perfectly fine, and every other app on my phone works without a problem.

I tried every troubleshooting step possible:
	•	Restarted the app
	•	Force-closed it
	•	Switched between WiFi and data
	•	Reinstalled the app
	•	Logged out and back in
	•	Restarted my phone
	•	Checked for updates
	•	Tried multiple presets

Nothing fixes it. The app simply doesn’t work.

On top of that, even though I already paid for the Lite & Pro subscription, the app constantly prompts me to buy the subscription again — as if my purchase doesn’t exist. It’s incredibly frustrating to pay for a service and then be locked out of using it almost immediately.

Until these issues are fixed, I can’t recommend this app. It has potential, but the constant errors and subscription glitches make it unusable. I hope Remini addresses these problems soon, because right now it’s not worth the money.
